Many pages are Vietnamese-language (bocongan.gov.vn, hungyen.gov.vn, camau.gov.vn, honda.com.vn, yamaha-motor.com.vn, petrolimex.com.vn, sovhttdl.hanoi.gov.vn PDF, sovhttdl.hungyen.gov.vn, puluong.web.vnptthanhhoa.com.vn, timbus.vn, xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn, metrohanoi.vn fares, dichvucong.bocongan.gov.vn, bachngoc.nghean.gov.vn, vinfastauto.com).

Honda Vietnam: hondaxemay.com.vn no longer serves product pages; the official manufacturer domain is honda.com.vn/xe-may, so the four Honda searches resolve there. Air Blade and Vision excerpts only partially capture the spec table (weight and dimensions); Future 125 FI and Wave Alpha 110 excerpts include the full spec table.

Plates (Circular 79/2024/TT-BCA): the bocongan.gov.vn article covers plate colours/series and foreign-vehicle codes (NG, QT, CV, NN) but not the per-province numeric codes table (Phu luc 02 of the Circular); no .gov.vn page with the province table was found.

Insurance (Decree 67/2023/ND-CP): no bocongan/chinhphu .gov.vn explainer with limits found; pbgdpl.camau.gov.vn (a provincial .gov.vn law-dissemination page) states the limits (150 million VND per person for health/life, 50 million VND per accident for property damage by motorbikes). The fetched excerpt is short; limits appear in the search excerpt of the same page.

Emissions roadmap: Decision 13/2026/QD-TTg (2 Apr 2026) - inspection starts 1 Jul 2027 in Hanoi and HCMC, 1 Jul 2028 other centrally-run cities, 1 Jul 2030 remaining provinces; from 1 Jan 2028 motorbikes in Hanoi/HCMC must meet Level 2+. hungyen.gov.vn fetch excerpt is partial; fuller text is on pbgdplthainguyen.gov.vn and xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn.

Hanoi parking fees: no hanoi.gov.vn page for the newest fee decision was reachable; resolved to a May 2026 Hanoi UBND plan PDF on sovhttdl.hanoi.gov.vn which states fees follow Decision 44/2017/QD-UBND and its amendments. NOTE: UBND Hanoi issued Decision 5794/QD-UBND on 15 Oct 2026 (new on-street parking prices: motorbikes 10,000 VND day / 15,000 night / 25,000 day+night, monthly 200,000-250,000 VND) per thanglong.chinhphu.vn and luatvietnam.vn; that decision was not available on a .gov.vn host at fetch time.

Hanoi bus fares: pbgdpl.hanoi.gov.vn article timed out / connection error on two attempts; resolved to timbus.vn (Transerco's official bus information portal, not transerco.com.vn) which carries the 1 Nov 2024 fare schedule (Decision 5290/QD-UBND): single fares 8,000-20,000 VND by distance; monthly passes 70,000/140,000 (priority), 100,000/200,000 (group), 140,000/280,000 (standard) single-route/inter-route.

Petrolimex: the retail price table on petrolimex.com.vn is rendered dynamically/as an image and is not captured in fetched text; resolved page is the 22 Oct 2026 press release (prices effective 15:00 22.10.2026). Search excerpts of petrolimex.com.vn showed prices updated 15/10/2026 (e.g. E10 RON 95-III 26,720 VND Vung 1; E5 RON 92 26,670 VND) and 8/10/2026 (E10 RON 95-III 28,250; E5 RON 92 27,700), i.e. figures change weekly.
Hanoi Metro: https://metrohanoi.vn/en (without query) did not render the station lists in fetched text; the ?noredirect=en_US variant did, so that URL is recorded.

Vietnam Railways: dsvn.vn luggage content is a 2006 regulation PDF (Decision 01/2006/QD-BGTVT, English); the current operator rule (20 kg hand luggage, per Circular 09/2018/TT-BGTVT) is on vr.com.vn (fetched but not recorded as it is not dsvn.vn).

Cat Ba: no haiphong.gov.vn or vietnam.travel page with ferry details found; catbanationalpark.com (national park site) recorded. Con Son - Kiep Bac resolved to vietnamtourism.gov.vn (national tourism authority .gov.vn), not haiduong.gov.vn; note Hai Duong merged into Hai Phong in 2025.

Low-emission zone: resolved to xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn (Government portal) article of 5 Jul 2026 publishing Hanoi's LEZ scheme (Decision 3273/QD-UBND): phase 1 1 Jul-31 Dec 2026 only Zones 1-2 of Hoan Kiem ward, no blanket petrol-motorbike ban on 1 Jul 2026; Directive 20/CT-TTg itself is at vanban.chinhphu.vn/?docid=214542 (not fetched).
thuvienphapluat.vn Circular 38/2024 page is paywalled; only document attributes returned (status error).
evisa.gov.vn home page excerpt is only the list of e-visa border gates; the FAQ page was fetched in full.

gov.uk, travel.state.gov, bocongan.gov.vn (drink-driving fines), metrohanoi.vn fares, cucphuongtourism, catbanationalpark, vietnamtourism.gov.vn, dsvn.vn PDF and vinfast Evo records use full-content fetches (large outputs persisted by the tool and merged here).
